title: Supervised Single-Flight Opaque Cleanup Proof and Two-Phase Fenced Reconciliation Architecture

governing_references.mandate: First confirm previous worker and group exited; then lookup exact operation ID on same DB. Present+matching digest reconciles original commit. Absent after writer quiescence proves no committed operation. No automatic blind apply/retry; any later attempt requires current fences and reviewed reconciliation policy.

findings_addressed: Exit 124/125 proves guardian cleanup, not before-commit: addressed by mandatory post-cleanup database receipt lookup separating process death from transaction commitment
Exit 125 means general failure, not only overflow: adopted comprehensive exit 125 taxonomy
Exit 126/port DOWN explicitly means cleanup UNKNOWN: adopted strict failure-to-unknown; never upgraded using flock
flock does not prove SQLite fcntl/WAL writer absence: flock assertions completely removed; writer absence established solely by observed supervisor/guardian process-tree reap
SHA digest is binding, not authenticity: trust originates strictly from observed pinned guardian lifecycle via internally constructed opaque Gleam proof
Avoid new native command/schema: adopted frozen v4 native protocol using clean guardian lookup query without native schema changes
Store uncertain result retains operation context and proof: adopted typed StoreUncertainty and ResponseDecodeError wrappers
No automatic retry/send: explicit service-layer fencing policy barring automatic resubmission on ReconciledAbsent

exit_0.meaning: Normal execution: child process reaped with waitpid, process group killed with SIGKILL, response emitted cleanly
exit_0.quiescence_witness: Eligible if response handling encounters transport/port drop

exit_124.meaning: Deadline/timeout: guardian hit deadline, killed child process and process group with SIGKILL, reaped child with waitpid within 0.5s grace
exit_124.quiescence_witness: Eligible (proves writer process tree is dead; does not prove whether COMMIT completed)

exit_125.meaning: General failure: framing error, buffer overflow (>1MB), child nonzero exit, or internal error; killed child and process group with SIGKILL, reaped child with waitpid within 0.5s grace
exit_125.quiescence_witness: Eligible (proves writer process tree is dead; does not prove whether COMMIT completed)

exit_126.meaning: Cleanup unconfirmed: guardian hit deadline or general failure, but child waitpid did not return within 0.5s grace period
exit_126.quiescence_witness: STRICTLY BARRED: cleanup is UNKNOWN. Never upgraded by flock or caller assertions

helper_down_catch_timeout.meaning: Port closed, Erlang catch, helper DOWN, or outer timeout before guardian exit message received
helper_down_catch_timeout.quiescence_witness: STRICTLY BARRED: cleanup is UNKNOWN. State remains held

internal_fields.operation_digest: String (SHA-256 of canonical apply request payload)

opaque_witness.constructor_visibility: Internal to telegram_store_transport only; NO public constructor exists

response_decode_error_type.purpose: A successful response that fails domain decode retains transport cleanup evidence and operation context without dropping them

transport_exchange_api.signature:
pub fn exchange_with_cleanup(
  config: LocalStoreConfig,
  body: String,
  operation_id: String,
  operation_digest: String,
) -> Result(String, #(Option(CleanupWitness), TransportError))

store_reconcile_api.signature:
pub fn reconcile_operation(
  config: LocalStoreConfig,
  bot_id: Int,
  operation_id: String,
  candidate_digest: String,
  witness: Option(CleanupWitness),
) -> Result(ReconciliationOutcome, StoreError)

phase_1_quiescence_check: 1. An operation returns uncertain from transport (e.g. timeout, port closed, or response decode failure).
2. Transport inspects guardian exit status: if exit is 126, port DOWN, or catch, witness is None.
3. If exit is 0, 124, or 125 with confirmed process tree reap: transport internally constructs Some(CleanupWitness) binding exact config, binary hashes, operation_id, and operation_digest.
4. The uncertain result is wrapped as StoreUncertainty(operation_id, candidate_digest, witness, reason).
phase_2_fenced_database_lookup: 1. Supervised single-flight owner enters RECONCILING state; no new mutations may be dispatched.
2. If witness is None: reconciliation immediately returns Ok(ReconciledUnknown('writer_quiescence_unproven')). State remains held; supervisor intervention (cgroup cleanup) is required.

3. If witness is Some(w): owner verifies that w.config_db_digest, w.native_bin_digest, w.guardian_bin_digest, w.operation_id, and w.operation_digest exactly match the reconciliation arguments. If any mismatch, returns Error(StoreInvariantError('quiescence_witness_binding_mismatch')).
4. Owner dispatches a clean, non-mutating lookup query (lookup_operation or read_keys on receipt) using the frozen v4 wire protocol.
5. Case A (Post-Commit Lost Response): The receipt table contains operation_id with matching digest. Outcome: Ok(ReconciledCommitted(receipt)). Original durable transition is recovered intact.

6. Case B (Timeout Before Commit): The receipt table contains no row for operation_id. Because w proves the writer process tree was killed and reaped before this query, no background commit can occur. Outcome: Ok(ReconciledAbsent(w)). Non-commitment is mathematically established.
7. Case C (Digest Conflict): The receipt table contains operation_id with a differing digest. Outcome: Ok(ReconciledConflict(candidate_digest, receipt)) -> Invariant failure HOLD.
8. ReconciledAbsent proves non-commitment, but NEVER automatically initiates an external HTTP send or blind retry. Any retry decision belongs strictly to the L3 service supervisor.

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Actual worker timeout before commit
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: Fixture pauses before COMMIT, guardian reaches deadline and exits 124, child process tree confirmed dead via waitpid

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Actual postcommit lost response
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: Fixture commits transaction to SQLite WAL, then sleeps until deadline, guardian exits 124/125
falsifiers_and_test_plan.expected_outcome: Receipt found in SQLite with matching digest -> Ok(ReconciledCommitted(receipt))

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Guardian exit 126 refuses proof
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: Fixture spawns stubborn child that ignores SIGTERM/SIGKILL, guardian cannot confirm reap within 0.5s and exits 126

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Helper crash / port DOWN refuses proof
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: Guardian executable terminates abnormally (SIGKILL) or port closes unexpectedly without exit status

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Mismatched witness binding rejected
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: Valid witness constructed for op-1 on db-A presented to reconcile op-2 or db-B
falsifiers_and_test_plan.action: Store verifies witness field bindings against request context

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Caller forgery impossibility
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: External code attempts to instantiate CleanupWitness
falsifiers_and_test_plan.expected_outcome: Compile-time error: CleanupWitness constructor is opaque and private to telegram_store_transport

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Domain decode failure retains cleanup evidence
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: Guardian exits 0 with malformed JSON body or invalid domain payload
falsifiers_and_test_plan.expected_outcome: Returns ResponseDecodeError retaining raw response, decode error, Some(witness), and operation context

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Zero-blind-retry enforcement
falsifiers_and_test_plan.expected_outcome: Storage layer returns terminal absence; zero HTTP network requests or automatic resubmissions occur

falsifiers_and_test_plan.title: Single-flight serialization
falsifiers_and_test_plan.setup: Store owner actor has an in-flight operation in RECONCILING state; concurrent caller attempts new mutation
falsifiers_and_test_plan.expected_outcome: Owner rejects or queues mutation; concurrent in-flight dispatch to same database is barred

implementation_scope_and_limits: Design proposal only; zero modifications to telegram_store_transport.gleam or telegram_store_transport_ffi.erl until proposal is root-reviewed and approved
Uses existing pinned guardian executable and frozen v4 wire protocol; no native schema changes
Supervisor restart and cgroup recovery of unproven quiescence remains within service scope
No production effects, no release grant, no merge to main bookmark
